Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3606 of 2024

Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sumit Goyal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Sumit Goyal, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri R.P. Patel, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Casse No.127 of 2021 arising out of Case Crime No.308 of 2020 registered under Sections 498A, 313, 323, 504,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act at Police Station- Badgaon, District Saharanpur with a prayer to enlarge her on anticipatory bail.

Usha Devi Alias Usha Rani vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165031489/
1 4.

entities.text: Usha Devi Alias Usha Rani vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the marriage of the son of the applicant Chetan was solemnized with the informant as per Hindu Rites on 12.05.2019 and the applicant and other co-accused persons are stated to have subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry of Rs.1,50,000/-, causing the termination of her pregnancy.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
She has nothing to do with the said offence.
She herself is a widow and there are general allegations against all the accused persons.
There is no injury report to corroborate the prosecution story and the allegations under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

Learned counsel has also placed much reliance upon the judgement ofSupreme Court passed in Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs. The State of Bihar, 2022(6) SCC 599, whereby it has been categorically stated that the Courts should be careful in proceeding against the distant relatives in crimes pertaining to matrimonial disputes and dowry deaths.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs. The State of Bihar, 2022(6) SCC 599
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The relatives of the husband should not be roped in on the basis of omnibus allegations unless specific instances of their involvement in the crime are made out.
Learned counsel has further stated that the applicant lives separately in the house opposite to the house of husband of the informant.
6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against her.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
There are no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
The applicant has apprehension of her arrest.

Learned counsel for the applicant undertakes that she has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
7. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

8. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of theSupreme Court.
9. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Usha Devi Alias Usha Rani vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Ravi Kant (Justice Krishan Pahal)
